capabilities: Show a floating toolbar above selected text
Apply Markdown formatting (bold, italic, highlight, headings, callouts) with one click
Pin the toolbar to the bottom of the screen in dock mode
Run a pomodoro timer with configurable work and break durations
extras: At the time of the README, submission to the Obsidian community plugin registry was still in progress; manual installation from release files is documented. Includes a pomodoro timer and session/note time tracking, which go beyond the formatting toolbar itself.
problem: Formatting selections requires hunting through menus, commands, or keyboard shortcuts, interrupting the flow while writing.
summary: Floating toolbar that pops up over selected text with one-click Markdown formatting buttons, plus an optional pomodoro focus timer HUD.
